lookup_spirv_opcodes: lookup SPIR-V opcodes and their numeric values from the spv['Op'] dictionary
lookup_spirv_capabilities: lookup SPIR-V capabilities and their numeric values from the spv['Capability'] dictionary
lookup_spirv_decorations: lookup SPIR-V decorations and their numeric values from the spv['Decoration'] dictionary
lookup_spirv_enumerations: lookup SPIR-V enumeration tokens like SourceLanguage, ExecutionModel, StorageClass from the spv dictionary
lookup_spirv_masks: lookup SPIR-V mask values and shift constants like ImageOperandsMask and ImageOperandsShift from the spv dictionary
